_comment: Image-text encoders, reached in-process rather than over an endpoint. `run_name` is the folder
under runs/; `repo_id` is the Hugging Face checkpoint. The text window, the embedding width and
the trained sigmoid boundary are read from the checkpoint itself, never listed here — a constant
that happens to match today is not evidence. Your own checkpoints go in encoders.local.json,
which is gitignored and overrides same-named entries here.

smoke.note: A throwaway run name for checking the whole chain on a handful of images. It writes to its own runs/ folder, so a quick check cannot collide with a real measurement's provenance.
